stories.headline: Anthropic Founders Cash Out in Record IPO
stories.deck: Seven founders sold nearly $2B in shares as the AI lab listed publicly.
stories.narration_text: TechCrunch reports Anthropic's seven founders sold nearly two billion dollars of shares in its record-setting I P O. The listing also highlights enormous future spending needs for the artificial intelligence company.

stories.headline: Can Smaller AI Models Beat the Big Ones?
stories.deck: Fireworks AI says tuned open models can cut business AI costs.
stories.narration_text: Fireworks A I argues companies can run smaller, tuned open models instead of always paying for the largest systems. The company is pursuing cheaper enterprise A I despite recent security incidents.

stories.headline: SpaceX Plans Rooftop Fix for Cell Dead Zones
stories.deck: Proposed micro towers would supplement direct-to-phone satellite signals.
stories.narration_text: SpaceX says small rooftop cell towers may fill indoor dead zones that satellites cannot reach. Elon Musk suggests production could begin in twenty twenty-seven, but the hardware is not yet commercially available.

stories.headline: Uber Tests Solo Rides for Kids as Young as 10
stories.deck: A limited pilot adds parent booking and more driver safeguards.
stories.narration_text: Uber is piloting rides for children as young as ten in three American cities. Parents must book trips, and selected drivers receive extra pay alongside added safety controls.

stories.headline: Ethereum Glamsterdam Upgrade Delayed to 2027
stories.deck: Developers need more time to protect apps from breaking changes.
stories.narration_text: Ethereum developers have pushed the Glamsterdam network upgrade into twenty twenty-seven. They need more time to fix smart contracts that could fail under proposed changes to network fees.

stories.headline: Coinbase Eyes Its Own Prediction Contracts
stories.deck: A reported 2027 target could lessen reliance on Kalshi.
stories.narration_text: Coinbase reportedly aims to launch its own American prediction contracts in the first half of twenty twenty-seven. The plan could reduce its dependence on prediction market partner Kalshi.

stories.headline: Bitcoin Drops Below $59,000 in Broad Selloff
stories.deck: Crypto liquidations added pressure amid selling in tech shares.
stories.narration_text: Bitcoin fell below fifty-nine thousand dollars Friday as crypto and technology shares sold off together. Heavy leveraged liquidations added pressure, according to CoinDesk. Prices remain volatile.
